mood: Premium, Confident, Motivating, Focused on Serious Study, Authoritative

typography.strategy: Swiss Brutalist (Tech/Authority) infused with high legibility for long study hours.

headings.usage: Use for Hero headings, Test titles, Dashboard metric numbers.

body.usage: Use for all reading materials, question text, chat bubbles, and general UI.

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight leading-none font-bold
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl tracking-tight leading-tight font-semibold

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous Spacing, F-Pattern Scanning, Progressive Disclosure.
spacing_and_layout.dashboard_grid: MODE B: THE CONTROL ROOM GRID. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6.
spacing_and_layout.padding_rules: Containers with borders MUST have internal padding (p-6 or p-8) to prevent text collision. Main page wrappers use px-4 md:px-8.
spacing_and_layout.alignment: Left-align dense text, questions, and test options. Only center-align Hero text or specific empty states.

components.buttons: Sharp or slightly rounded (rounded-md). No excessive pill shapes unless for badges. High contrast. Primary uses bg-slate-900 text-white (light). Accent CTAs use bg-orange-600 text-white.
components.cards: Subtle border (border-border), Flat background, no soft muddy shadows. Hover: Slight lift (-translate-y-1) + shadow-lg.
components.inputs_and_forms: Shadcn customized. Solid borders (border-slate-300). Focus state MUST use focus:ring-2 focus:ring-orange-500 focus:border-orange-500. No native <input>.
components.navigation: Sticky top nav with Crystal Glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 or bg-slate-900/80) and 1px bottom border. Side navigation for dashboard modules.
components.test_engine: Focus mode layout (hide main nav during tests). Persistent top bar timer. Side/Bottom palette for question jumping (color coded: Green=Answered, Red=Unanswered, Purple=Marked for Review).
components.chat_ui: Split-screen layout (PDF/Material on Left, Chat on Right) similar to high-end academic reading tools.
components.charts: Recharts. Use functional colors (Green for accuracy/growth, Orange for time taken). No hover-required data; core numbers must be visible instantly.

images.description: Focused young Indian woman reading a textbook at a library desk, setting a serious study mood.
Clean, minimalist architectural abstract for subtle section backgrounds.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 contrast for all text. Use text-shadow if placing text over images.
accessibility.hover_states: Always explicitly set text color on hover (e.g., hover:bg-slate-900 hover:text-white).
accessibility.testing_attributes: All interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs, test options, tabs) MUST include 'data-testid' attributes (e.g., data-testid='start-mock-test-btn').

instructions_to_main_agent: Initialize Tailwind config with the specified color palette and font families (Outfit and Manrope).
Apply 'Control Room' grid for the Analytics Dashboard to ensure density and clarity.
Build the 'Chat with Material' interface as a side-by-side split layout rather than a floating modal.
For the Test Engine: Design a rigorous, distraction-free UI. Implement a color-coded question palette (Answered, Not Answered, Marked for Review).
Avoid Vercel/Stripe default looks. Use the deep slate and energetic orange accents to create a distinctive brand identity.
Never use purely transparent backgrounds on headers; always use backdrop-blur or solid colors.
Implement charts using Recharts with clear, upfront data labels.
Ensure the application strictly uses .js files for React components as per environment setup.
Inject data-testid on every clickable or actionable element for testing.
